name: Synchrony - A ZoSan Fan Visual Novel
source:
After splitting up for the day, both Zoro and Sanji start to feel off-balance. When Zoro makes his way thru town looking for his partner, he discovers Sanji is missing. Will he be able to find him? Or is it too late for the cook?

[From [url=https://darkchibishadow.itch.io/synchrony]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一天结束、各自分开后，索隆和山治都开始感到不对劲。索隆穿过城镇寻找自己的搭档，却发现山治失踪了。他能找到山治吗？还是对这位厨师来说已经太迟了？

[来源：[url=https://darkchibishadow.itch.io/synchrony]itch.io[/url]]
